name: V-Triune
description: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming an important direction for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but public training methodologies for unified multimodal RL remain much less mature, especially for heterogeneous reasoning and perception-heavy tasks. We propose V-Triune, a Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning methodology for unified multimodal RL. It organizes training around three coordinated abstractions: Sample-Level Reward Routing, Verifier-Level Outcome Verification, and Source-Level Diagnostics.
